summary: Iter110 FRONTEND ONLY, mobile 390x844, employee kiosk (Anita PIN 4321, my-awesome-rentals-bv). Retest of the iteration_109 fixes, with a real fake-printer WebSocket client keeping 'TEST KTP iter110' online. All requested checks passed. (B-fix) Simulated KT-V520 (ReactNativeWebView + __SURIRENT_KTP__) while a KT-V520 is online: the history-print-{id} menu shows only history-print-local-{id} 'Ingebouwde printer', with no history-print-ktp-*. The voice-modal history-print-fin menu also shows only 'Ingebouwde printer'. In Bonnen van vandaag each row has only kiosk-print-log-print-{id} 'Ingebouwde printer': a single line, height 40px with scrollHeight 40, and no 'Print via KT-V520' button. (Voice row) Normal browser, no printers: voice-modal-print-row is not rendered and the 'Financiële bon' text is absent. With a KT-V520 online: the row is rendered and history-print-fin offers only history-print-ktp-fin. With a fake Bluetooth printer the row is also rendered. (Header) In employee mode the Bonnen header shows only the name, with no online/offline label. In admin mode (admin_token in localStorage) 'offline' is fully visible (scrollWidth 36 = clientWidth 36); the name is truncated with an ellipsis ('Anita Se…'). (Regression) A: normal browser with no printers shows no history-print-*, no voice row and no Bonnen print buttons, and window.print was called 0 times. C: normal browser with a KT-V520 online shows only KTP in the history menu, the fin menu and Bonnen (kiosk-print-log-ktp-{id}), and no built-in option. D: fake Web Bluetooth shows history-print-bt-{id} 'Print via Bluetooth — BT Test Printer'; clicking it wrote 38 chunks and the status reads 'Geprint op BT Test Printer'.

design_issues.screen: Bonnen van vandaag employee picker (employee mode)
issues: Still left over from iter109 and not part of this retest scope: every employee card in kiosk-prints-employee-{key} shows 'Offline' in employee mode, including the employee who is logged in. Consider hiding the online/offline badge in employeeMode, as the header now does.
Cosmetic: the employee name is cut to 'Anita Se…' to make room for the 'offline' label. It is acceptable, but a 2-line layout or a smaller label would show more of the name.

action_items: Optional: hide the online/offline badge on employee picker cards in employeeMode (KioskPrintsOverlay line ~29).
critical_code_review_comments: usePrintOptions centralizes the option logic: builtIn means first=null, so a KT-V520 never offers itself. KioskPrintsOverlay gates KtpPrintButton with !isKtpDevice(). The voice row is gated on printOpts.any. All of this is clean.

Every simulated KT-V520 session with fresh localStorage still auto-registers 'KT-V520 #N' (6 were created during this run). This is expected on real hardware, but consider reusing an existing device by fingerprint to avoid printer clutter.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (B-fix 3/3, voice row 3/3, header 2/2, regression A/C/D all pass)

HUIS 1B has payment history; HUIS 2C has an amount owed, so the voice button is enabled there. Bonnen needs payments made today: run pay_iter110.py.
